#### Set up copies of R running in parallel. I played it safe and used about half of available cores. This was probably overcautious 
```{r}
#cores <- detectCores() - 1 

cores <- 50
cl <- makeCluster(cores)

```

### Specify  correlation structures
```{r}
corStructs <- list(corGaus(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corExp(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corLin(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corRatio(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corSpher(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE) )
```

#### File Paths
```{r}
out_path <-  here("Output/Spatial/GAM")
if(!dir.exists(out_path)) dir.create(out_path)
```

#### Datasets for gamms
```{r}
all_species <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/all_species.rds"))
wc <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/wc.rds"))
hs <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/hs.rds"))
#hs_no_zeros <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/hs_no_zeros.rds"))

# get all datasets in a list
datasets <- list(all_species, wc, hs)
names(datasets) <- c("all_species", "wc", "hs")
```

#### Get formulas for all combinations of smooths for use doing gamms on all combinations of smooths
```{r}
smooths <- c(
  's(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr")', 
  's(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr")', 
  's(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr")',
  's(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr")',
  's(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")',
  's(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr")',
  's(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr")',
  's(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr")'
            )

# Generate all subsets of all possible lengths
all_combos <- unlist(lapply(1:length(smooths), function(n) combn(smooths, n, FUN=function(row) paste0("species.richness ~ ", paste0(row, collapse = "+")))))

all_combos[[1]]

```

#### get combinations of names of predictor values corresponding to smooths for use in a spread sheet for asv.hp, in combination with adjustd r-squared values from corresponding gamms
```{r}
simple_terms <- c('temp', 'prec', 'wet', 'ph', 'nitrogen', 'trees', 'pesticide', 'humans')

# Generate all subsets of all possible lengths
term_combos <- unlist(lapply(1:length(simple_terms), function(n) combn(simple_terms, n, FUN=function(row)  paste0(row, collapse = "+"))))
term_combos[[1]]
```

#### Run gamms for all combinations of smooths for all species
```{r}
# set file path
filedir <- paste0(here(out_path), "/GAMM_all_species/factorial/")
if(!dir.exists(filedir)) dir.create(filedir)
filedir

#set up cluster
cl <- makeCluster(cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

#do gamms in parralel
# Use .combine to format the output (e.g., 'c' for a vector, 'rbind' 
result_list <- foreach(i = 1:length(all_combos), .packages = "mgcv", .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
tryCatch({
igamm <- gamm(as.formula(all_combos[[i]]), 
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
  # print time in console
  cat("Iteration:", i, "| Time:", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
  #flush.console()  
  
  # Create a unique filename dynamically
  igamm_name <- paste0("gamm_iteration_", i, ".rds")
  ifilepath <- paste0(filedir, igamm_name)
  saveRDS(igamm, file = ifilepath)
  
  igamm
}, error = function(e) {
    # Action to take if an error occurs
    warning(paste("Failed processing element:", i, "-", e$message))
    return(NULL) # Return a default safe value
  })
 }
# Output: list(2, 4, 6)

stopCluster(cl)

#print some summaries
summary(result_list[[1]]$gam)
summary(result_list[[22]]$gam)
summary(result_list[[255]]$gam)

#write to file
filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_model_select_factorial.rds")
filepath
write_rds(result_list, 
          file = filepath)

```

#### Variation partitioning for all species
```{r}
as_gamms <- readRDS(here("./Output/Spatial/GAM/GAMM_all_species/factorial//gamm_model_select_factorial.rds"))

rsq1 <- summary(as_gamms[[1]]$gam)$r.sq

#Extract adjusted r squared value from gamm models
rsqs <- sapply(as_gamms,function(x) {
  summary(x$gam)$r.sq
}) 

# Make a dataframe where first column is terms in the model and second is adusted r-squared
my.hp.data <- data.frame(cbind(term_combos, rsqs))

#change negative r squared values to zero
my.hp.data$rsqs <- if_else(rsqs < 0, 0, rsqs)

# Hierarchical partitioning based on ASV
asv.hp(my.hp.data)

# Hierarchical partitioning and commonality analysis
asv.hp(my.hp.data, commonality = TRUE)


filedir <- paste0(here(out_path), "/GAMM_all_species/factorial/")
filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_as_hp_data.rds")
filepath
write_rds(my.hp.data, 
          file = filepath)

# filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_as_hp_data_nonneg.rds")
# filepath
# write_rds(my.hp.data, 
#           file = filepath)
```

#### Run gamms for all combinations of smooths for hs species
```{r}
# set file path
filedir <- paste0(here(out_path), "/GAMM_hs/factorial/")
if(!dir.exists(filedir)) dir.create(filedir)
filedir

#set up cluster
cl <- makeCluster(cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

#do gamms in parralel
# Use .combine to format the output (e.g., 'c' for a vector, 'rbind' 
result_list <- foreach(i = 1:length(all_combos), .packages = "mgcv", .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
tryCatch({
  options(mgcv.vc.logrange = 5)
  lmeCtlList=lmeControl(niterEM = 50, msMaxIter = 1000, msMaxEval = 1000)
igamm <- gamm(as.formula(all_combos[[i]]), 
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663),    
  control=lmeCtlList,
  correlation = corStructs[[1]],
  data = datasets$hs$gamm_input)
  # print time in console
  cat("Iteration:", i, "| Time:", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
  #flush.console()  
  
  # Create a unique filename dynamically
  igamm_name <- paste0("gamm_iteration_", i, ".rds")
  ifilepath <- paste0(filedir, igamm_name)
  saveRDS(igamm, file = ifilepath)
  
  igamm
}, error = function(e) {
    # Action to take if an error occurs
    warning(paste("Failed processing element:", i, "-", e$message))
    return(NULL) # Return a default safe value
  })
 }
# Output: list(2, 4, 6)

stopCluster(cl)

#print some summaries
summary(result_list[[1]]$gam)
summary(result_list[[22]]$gam)
summary(result_list[[255]]$gam)

#write to file
filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_model_select_factorial.rds")
filepath
write_rds(result_list, 
          file = filepath)

```
# try to get model 77 to converg
```{r}
# get formula
#as.formula(all_combos[[77]])

# increase msMaxIter and msMaxEvalto 2000 each but then got this error

# Error in lme.formula(fixed = fixed, random = random, data = data, correlation = correlation, :
# nlminb problem, convergence error code = 1
# message = false convergence (8)

#reduce k to 5

options(mgcv.vc.logrange = 5)
  lmeCtlList=lmeControl(niterEM = 50, msMaxIter = 2000, msMaxEval = 2000)
gamm.77 <- gamm(species.richness ~ s(topographic.wetness, k = 5, bs = "cr") + 
    s(total.n, k = 5, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 5, bs = "cr"), 
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663),    
  control=lmeCtlList,
  correlation = corStructs[[1]],
  data = datasets$hs$gamm_input)

summary(gamm.77$gam)

# add this one to results list
hs_gamms <- readRDS(here("./Output/Spatial/GAM/GAMM_hs/factorial//gamm_model_select_factorial.rds"))
hs_gamms[[77]] <- gamm.77
filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_model_select_factorial.rds")
filepath
write_rds(hs_gamms, 
          file = filepath)
```
